## Key Projects & Case Studies
1. Steele Auto Group (steeleauto.com): Enterprise automotive network (56 dealerships). Custom PHP, ACF flexible content modules, high-speed custom architecture.
2. Spazietto (spazietto.com): Luxury Italian-inspired cabinetry brand. Custom PHP plugins, ACF integration, bespoke layout system.
3. Digi Consulting Group (digiconsultinggroup.com): Digital transformation firm. Built with Next.js App Router, Three.js 3D canvas, and Tailwind.
4. Pulse Drink (pulsedrink.com): High-energy beverage brand showcase built on Framer with custom motion physics.
